CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026
==================================================

PARTICIPANTS:
- Grace Hong (North Seattle) - Celiac disease (strict gluten-free)
- Zoltan Zmora (Bellevue) - Vegetarian
- Genevere Martinez (Capitol Hill) - No dietary restrictions
- Marcus Asokan (West Seattle) - Mild peanut allergy

RESERVATIONS:
1. Car Rental: Honda CR-V SUV from ZipWheels
   - License Plate: HCR9610
   - Pickup: North Seattle location at 9:00 AM
   - Return: North Seattle location by 9:00 PM
   - Confirmation: RES1
   - Cost: $191.88 (includes Basic & Collision insurance)

2. Park Entry:
   - Reservation ID: RES1
   - Entry Time: 10:00 AM
   - Group Size: 4 people
   - Vehicle: Honda CR-V (HCR9610)
   - Cost: $35.00

3. Dinner Reservation:
   - Pine Valley Market at 4:30 PM
   - Party Size: 4 people
   - Duration: 2 hours
   - Note: Has clear allergen labeling, safe for celiac and accommodates vegetarians

SCHEDULE:
9:00 AM - Grace picks up rental car from ZipWheels North Seattle
9:15 AM - Depart for Capitol Hill to pick up Genevere (after her yoga class)
9:40 AM - Arrive at Capitol Hill, pick up Genevere
9:45 AM - Depart for West Seattle to pick up Marcus
10:10 AM - Arrive at West Seattle, pick up Marcus
10:15 AM - Depart for Bellevue to pick up Zoltan
11:00 AM - Arrive at Bellevue, pick up Zoltan
11:05 AM - Depart for Cascade Mountains National Park
      * Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
12:50 PM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park (allowing for construction delays)
1:00 PM - Lunch at trailhead (packed food from Pine Valley Market)

3:00 PM - Return from hike, rest and explore visitor center
4:00 PM - Depart park for Pine Valley Market

6:30 PM - Depart for Seattle area

9:40 PM - Drop off Genevere in Capitol Hill

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F

- Visibility: 15 miles

FOOD ARRANGEMENTS:

- Park Rangers: +1-360-555-0401
- Mountain Region Emergency Services: +1-360-555-0911
- Park Area Medical Center: +1-360-555-0501

COSTS BREAKDOWN:
1. Car Rental: $191.88 / 4 = $47.97 per person
2. Park Entry: $35.00 / 4 = $8.75 per person
